name: Buttermilk Pie
desc: A Southern custard pie of buttermilk, butter and sugar, brightened with lemon and nutmeg.

source.title: Buttermilk Pie
source.evidence: Same eggs, butter, flour, buttermilk and lemon juice; supplies the nutmeg (1/8-1/4 tsp, rounded to 1/4) and the unbaked 9-inch crust. Kept the site's 1 1/2 cups sugar.

ingredients.raw: 1 (9-inch) deep-dish unbaked pie crust, store-bought or homemade
1/2 cup (1 stick) unsalted butter, melted and cooled 15 minutes

steps: Melt the butter and let it cool at least 15 minutes. Preheat the oven to 350°F and set the pie crust on a rimmed baking sheet.
Whisk the eggs in a large bowl until frothy. Whisk in the cooled butter, sugar and flour until smooth.
Stir in the buttermilk, vanilla, lemon juice and nutmeg, then pour into the crust.
Bake 40-60 minutes, until the edges are set and golden and the center jiggles only slightly when the pan is nudged. If the crust edge browns too fast, cover it with foil.
Cool on a rack at least 2 hours so the custard finishes setting. Serve at room temperature or chilled.
tips: Small Town Woman uses 1 1/4 cups sugar, pre-bakes the crust 5 to 6 minutes at 400°F, then bakes the pie 10 minutes at 400°F and 40 to 45 minutes at 350°F.

references.title: Buttermilk Pie Recipe
references.usedFor: room-temperature eggs and buttermilk, cooling the melted butter, deep-dish crust, slight-jiggle doneness cue, alternate bake schedule
